integrity: The characteristic-two theorem is supported by an arbitrary-dimension proof using a single-Jordan-block ideal classification and Lucas parity of binomial coefficients. The bundled verifier independently checks integer Zinbiel identities, parity, ideal cutoffs, and small-field ideal lattices; those finite tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns the canonical binomial null-filiform Zinbiel family over characteristic-two fields and the abelian-ideal invariant beta, not general Zinbiel algebras or the abelian-subalgebra invariant alpha.
Other positive prime characteristics are not classified.
Related modular-shuffle or nilpotent-filtration descriptions might contain a differently worded equivalent result.
title: Binary-carry thresholds for maximal abelian ideals in modular null-filiform Zinbiel algebras
